title: Goan Mushroom and Snow Pea Curry
subtitle: with Cashews and Steamed Rice
description: Loaded with mushrooms, snow peas and mild aromatic spices, this vegan dish hits the spot if you love curry but don't like it too spicy. Top with cashews and serve with fragrant jasmine rice.

steps.text: Cook rice: Rinse the rice until the water runs clear. Put in a small saucepan with 250ml (1 cup) water, cover and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Reduce the heat to low and cook for 12 mins or until tender and the water is absorbed. Turn off the heat and stand, covered, for at least 5 mins.

Prep ingredients: Meanwhile, thinly slice the onion. Quarter the mushrooms. Trim the stems from the snow peas, removing the strings from one side, then halve on an angle. Roughly chop the cashews. Crush or finely chop 1 garlic clove.

Cook veggies: Heat 2 tsp vegetable oil in a medium deep frypan over medium heat. Add the onion and mushrooms and cook, stirring, for 5 mins or until softened. Add the curry paste and garlic and cook, stirring, for 1 min or until fragrant.

Simmer curry: Add the coconut milk and 80ml (⅓ cup) water to the mushroom mixture, season with salt and pepper and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 10 mins or until the sauce is slightly reduced. Stir in the snow peas and cook for a further 3 mins or until the snow peas are just tender.
Serve up: Divide the rice and curry among bowls. Scatter over the cashews and enjoy!

Did you know?: Goan curry paste is a mild Indian paste usually used to make fish or veggie curries. It contains fennel, garam masala, ginger, cloves and a hint of chilli. When mixed with coconut milk, which balances the spices perfectly, it makes for a great mild, creamy curry.
